notes:
Lead: AstraPrompt Support Labs — mid-market ecommerce platform focused on personalized offers and high-volume support.

POC scope: 6-week pilot to connect Zendesk + Freshdesk, ingest ~12 months of ticket history (~2M tickets), real-time webhook for new tickets. Deliverables: 1) concise 2-3 sentence ticket summaries, 2) priority suggestion, 3) auto-tags (product, intent, sentiment), 4) suggested macro and confidence score, 5) tool-calls: create Jira when 'bug' or 'engineering' tag, post Slack to #support-escalations, call internal Refund API.

Performance & reliability targets: median summarization latency <750ms, 95th <2s for non-VIP; tagging precision >85% for top-3 tags; baseline throughput 200 req/min with spike capacity to 1500 req/min during flash sales and graceful degradation (fallback cached summaries / smaller model).

Model preference: prefer quantized open models for cost control (Llama2-13B q4/vicuna-like) but want A/B against larger models for VIP routing. Request for model routing policy: high-quality model for VIP and high-uncertainty tickets, cheaper fast model for bulk.

Security/compliance: must support Okta SSO (SAML), SOC2 posture required, KMS envelope encryption for keys, per-request audit logging for inference, data retention 30 days for PII by default, EU data residency for EU shoppers.

Integration notes: Currently on Zendesk + Freshdesk, Jira, Slack, AWS (us-east-1), Okta. Asking for an option between Redwood Hosted API (fast start) vs Dedicated VPC (preferred for compliance). Freshdesk macro automation needs webhook examples.

Recent timeline (CRM bullets):
- 2025-10-28: Intro call (AE Jordan Reyes). Prospect: "we see big spikes during sales — reliability is make-or-break".
- 2025-11-03: Technical deep dive with SE Priya Malik (Fireflies ff_2025-11-03_7492). SE asked for sample tickets and schema export.
- 2025-11-05: Pricing / SOW draft sent (drive link). Gmail thread thread-f:CAKsdjf9-ppq20251105@group.mail.
- 2025-11-10: Security questionnaire submitted; legal raised EU data residency concern (ticket SEC-1187).
- 2025-11-12: Product ops verbally approved pilot pending SAML test and final budget sign-off.

POC milestones & success metrics: connector + live webhook in week 1, initial model for summarization + tagging week 2-3, accuracy tuning and macros week 4, tool-call automation testing week 5, pilot metrics review and decision week 6. Acceptance criteria: summaries accurate enough for first-contact resolution suggestions, auto-tagging true positive >85%, <2s 95th latency under expected load.

Open questions / blockers: legal needs explicit EU residency guarantee for EU customer data; schedule window for SAML metadata exchange (Okta team only available 11/20-11/24); budget sign-off needed for Dedicated GPU reserve if cost of hosted API at projected volume exceeds $7k/mo.

Next steps: send SAML metadata and technical connector spec (AE), schedule infra sizing call 2025-11-18 (SE + infra), finalize SOW for signature by 2025-11-25.

Stakes: VP Support: "if summaries are wrong we lose trust with customers". CTO: prefers open models "for cost and fine-grain control over inference" but willing to test Redwood Optimize recommendations.
